metadata.source: Research compilation — curated historical fiction works
metadata.description: Works-dense batch to push entity count past 3,000 — historical novels, films, TV series, plays, and games not yet in the knowledge graph.

figures.name: Puyi
figures.title: Last Emperor of China
figures.description: Ascended the Qing throne at age two, became puppet ruler of Japanese-controlled Manchukuo, and was re-educated as a common citizen under Mao's China

figures.name: Tokugawa Tsunayoshi
figures.title: 5th Tokugawa Shogun
figures.description: Known as the Dog Shogun for his laws protecting animals, he presided over the Genroku cultural renaissance but impoverished the samurai class

figures.name: Nader Shah
figures.title: Shah of Iran
figures.description: The Napoleon of Persia who created a vast empire from India to the Caucasus, sacked Delhi and seized the Peacock Throne, assassinated by his own officers

figures.name: Tamerlane
figures.title: Turco-Mongol conqueror
figures.description: Brutal conqueror who built an empire spanning from India to Turkey, massacring millions, yet his capital Samarkand became a center of art and architecture

figures.name: Vlad the Impaler
figures.title: Voivode of Wallachia
figures.description: The historical Dracula, a Wallachian prince who defended his kingdom against the Ottomans through extreme brutality, inspiring Bram Stoker's vampire novel

figures.name: Dido Elizabeth Belle
figures.title: Georgian era gentlewoman
figures.description: Mixed-race daughter of a Royal Navy captain raised by the Earl of Mansfield, whose presence in the household may have influenced the landmark Somersett slavery case

figures.name: Emiliano Zapata
figures.title: Mexican revolutionary leader
figures.description: Leader of the agrarian revolution in southern Mexico who fought for land reform under the banner 'Tierra y Libertad' before being ambushed and killed

figures.name: Patrice Lumumba
figures.title: First Prime Minister of the Congo
figures.description: Pan-African hero who led the Congo to independence from Belgium, overthrown in a CIA-backed coup and assassinated just months after taking office

figures.name: Toussaint Louverture
figures.title: Leader of the Haitian Revolution
figures.description: Former slave who led the only successful slave revolution in history, defeating French, Spanish, and British forces to establish Haiti as the first free Black republic

figures.name: Laskarina Bouboulina
figures.title: Greek naval commander
figures.description: One of the few female admirals in naval history who built and commanded her own warship to fight for Greek independence from the Ottoman Empire

works.title: The Handmaid's Tale (novel)
works.creator: Margaret Atwood
works.description: Dystopian novel about a totalitarian theocracy that has subjugated women, told through the eyes of a handmaid forced into reproductive servitude

works.title: Hilary Mantel's Bring Up the Bodies
works.creator: Hilary Mantel
works.description: Booker Prize-winning sequel to Wolf Hall following Thomas Cromwell as he orchestrates the downfall of Anne Boleyn

works.title: The Mirror and the Light
works.creator: Hilary Mantel
works.description: Final volume of the Cromwell trilogy following Thomas Cromwell from the execution of Anne Boleyn to his own downfall

works.title: Belle
works.creator: Amma Asante
works.description: Period drama inspired by the true story of Dido Elizabeth Belle, a mixed-race woman raised in aristocratic Georgian England

works.title: Hotel Rwanda
works.creator: Terry George
works.description: True story of a hotel manager who sheltered over a thousand Tutsi refugees during the Rwandan genocide

works.title: The Last Temptation of Christ
works.creator: Martin Scorsese
works.description: Controversial adaptation exploring Jesus experiencing human desires and doubts

works.title: Dracula
works.creator: Bram Stoker
works.description: Gothic horror novel about Count Dracula's attempt to move from Transylvania to England, inspired by Vlad the Impaler

works.title: Dune
works.creator: Frank Herbert
works.description: Science fiction epic drawing heavily on Middle Eastern and feudal history, exploring themes of imperialism, ecology, and messianism on a desert planet

works.title: Dune (2021)
works.creator: Denis Villeneuve
works.description: Visually stunning adaptation of Frank Herbert's epic about a young nobleman's destiny on the desert planet Arrakis

works.title: Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind
works.creator: Yuval Noah Harari
works.description: Sweeping history of humanity from the Stone Age to the present, exploring how Homo sapiens came to dominate the planet through cognitive, agricultural, and scientific revolutions

works.title: SPQR: A History of Ancient Rome
works.creator: Mary Beard
works.description: Acclaimed history of Rome from its founding myths through the granting of citizenship to all free inhabitants in 212 AD, challenging traditional narratives

works.title: Genghis Khan and the Making of the Modern World
works.creator: Jack Weatherford
works.description: Reassessment of Genghis Khan as a progressive force who promoted religious tolerance, free trade, and diplomatic immunity across his vast empire

works.title: Guns, Germs, and Steel
works.creator: Jared Diamond
works.description: Pulitzer Prize-winning exploration of why Eurasian civilizations conquered others, arguing geography and environment rather than racial superiority shaped history

works.title: 1491: New Revelations of the Americas Before Columbus
works.creator: Charles C. Mann
works.description: Groundbreaking account of the pre-Columbian Americas, revealing sophisticated civilizations far more populous and complex than previously imagined

works.title: Persepolis
works.creator: Marjane Satrapi
works.description: Graphic memoir about growing up during the Iranian Revolution and the Iran-Iraq War, told with humor and poignancy through stark black-and-white art

works.title: Maus
works.creator: Art Spiegelman
works.description: Pulitzer Prize-winning graphic novel depicting the Holocaust through the eyes of the author's father, with Jews drawn as mice and Nazis as cats

works.title: The Diary of a Young Girl
works.creator: Anne Frank
works.description: The diary of a Jewish girl hiding from the Nazis in Amsterdam, one of the most widely read books in the world and a powerful testament to the human spirit

works.title: Night
works.creator: Elie Wiesel
works.description: Harrowing memoir of a teenage boy's experience in Auschwitz and Buchenwald concentration camps during the Holocaust

works.title: Things Fall Apart
works.creator: Chinua Achebe
works.description: The most widely read novel in African literature, depicting the collision between Igbo culture and British colonialism through the tragedy of a proud warrior

works.title: A Thousand Splendid Suns
works.creator: Khaled Hosseini
works.description: Novel about two Afghan women whose lives intertwine against the backdrop of three decades of war, from Soviet invasion through Taliban rule

works.title: Memoirs of a Geisha (novel)
works.creator: Arthur Golden
works.description: Novel narrated by a geisha in Kyoto telling the story of her life from childhood poverty to becoming one of Japan's most celebrated geisha

works.title: The Physician
works.creator: Noah Gordon
works.description: Adventure novel about an English orphan who travels to 11th-century Persia to study medicine under the great physician Avicenna

works.title: Aztec
works.creator: Gary Jennings
works.description: Epic historical novel narrated by an old Aztec man recounting his life from boyhood to the fall of Tenochtitlan to Hernan Cortes

works.title: Musashi (novel)
works.creator: Eiji Yoshikawa
works.description: Epic fictionalized account of the life of Miyamoto Musashi, Japan's most famous swordsman, one of the best-selling novels in Japanese history

works.title: The Devourers
works.creator: Indra Das
works.description: Dark fantasy woven through Indian history, following a half-human who encounters tales of shapeshifters spanning from Mughal India to modern Kolkata

works.title: An Artist of the Floating World
works.creator: Kazuo Ishiguro
works.description: An aging Japanese painter in post-war Japan reflects on his career and its complicity with militarism, exploring memory, guilt, and self-deception

works.title: The Poisonwood Bible
works.creator: Barbara Kingsolver
works.description: An American missionary family in the Belgian Congo during the independence era, told through four daughters' perspectives as their lives diverge

works.title: Shogan
works.creator: James Clavell
works.description: Epic historical novel about an English navigator in feudal Japan

works.title: Tai-Pan
works.creator: James Clavell
works.description: Novel about the founding of Hong Kong and the rivalries between British and Chinese traders in the aftermath of the First Opium War

works.title: King Doha
works.creator: James Clavell
works.description: Cold War thriller set in 1960s Hong Kong, following the head of a powerful trading company through a week of financial intrigue and espionage

works.title: The Clan of the Cave Bear
works.creator: Jean M. Auel
works.description: Prehistoric fiction about a Cro-Magnon girl adopted by a Neanderthal clan, set during the Ice Age, launching the bestselling Earth's Children series

works.title: Aztec Blood
works.creator: Gary Jennings
works.description: Sequel to Aztec following a half-Spanish, half-Aztec boy through colonial Mexico's violent underworld of corruption, Inquisition, and piracy

works.title: Hild
works.creator: Nicola Griffith
works.description: Historical novel about Hild of Whitby, a young woman navigating the treacherous politics of 7th-century Britain as advisor to her uncle, King Edwin of Northumbria

works.title: The Last Days of Night
works.creator: Graham Moore
works.description: Novel about the War of the Currents between Thomas Edison and George Westinghouse, told through their young lawyer Paul Cravath

works.title: The Personal History of David Copperfield
works.creator: Armando Iannucci
works.description: Fresh adaptation of Dickens's autobiographical novel with colorblind casting, following David from childhood hardship to literary success in Victorian England

works.title: The Favourite
works.creator: Yorgos Lanthimos
works.description: Darkly comic period drama about the rivalry between two cousins vying for the favor of the ailing Queen Anne in early 18th-century England

works.title: The Dig
works.creator: Simon Stone
works.description: Drama about the excavation of Sutton Hoo in 1939, on the eve of World War II, uncovering an Anglo-Saxon ship burial of extraordinary significance

works.title: RRR
works.creator: S. S. Rajamouli
works.description: Indian epic action drama imagining a fictional friendship between two real Indian revolutionaries fighting against British colonial rule

works.title: Oppenheimer
works.creator: Christopher Nolan
works.description: Epic biographical film about J. Robert Oppenheimer and the development of the atomic bomb during the Manhattan Project

works.title: Napoleon (2023)
works.creator: Ridley Scott
works.description: Epic historical drama following Napoleon Bonaparte's rise to power, his military campaigns, and his volatile relationship with Empress Josephine

works.title: Hacksaw Ridge
works.creator: Mel Gibson
works.description: True story of Desmond Doss, a conscientious objector who became the first non-combatant to receive the Medal of Honor for saving 75 men at Okinawa

works.title: The Dig (novel)
works.creator: John Preston
works.description: Novel about the excavation of Sutton Hoo told from the perspectives of the people involved in the discovery

works.title: Empress of Salt and Fortune
works.creator: Nghi Vo
works.description: Fantasy novella drawing on Vietnamese and Chinese imperial history about a cleric uncovering the hidden history of an empress who changed the world
works.setting: Fantasy, inspired by East Asian history

properties.notes: Vlad the Impaler was the inspiration for Count Dracula
Musashi is the subject of the novel
